items.heading: Hainanese Chicken Rice
details: Key ingredients: chicken, rice, ginger, garlic, chili sauce
Poach a whole chicken gently in aromatic broth until just cooked.
Cook rice in the reserved chicken fat and broth.
Slice the chicken and serve over the fragrant rice.
Serve with ginger-garlic sauce, chili sauce and dark soy sauce.

items.heading: Laksa
details: Key ingredients: rice noodles, coconut milk, shrimp, laksa paste
Fry a fragrant laksa spice paste until aromatic.
Add coconut milk and stock, simmering into a rich broth.
Cook rice noodles and add shrimp or chicken to the broth.
Ladle the broth over the noodles and top with bean sprouts and herbs.

items.heading: Chilli Crab
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
